biotools.summary: PrimalScheme is an open-source toolkit and website for designing primer panels for multiplex PCR, enabling low-cost viral genome sequencing. It uses a greedy algorithm to find primers for tiling amplicon generation for multiple reference genomes, supporting a global community of researchers.
